steps.what: List validation test equipment due for service
Maintain validation test equipment on the bench

outputs: filed copy of signed maintenance note v1

tasks.design: A job lists equipment already due in {OPS_SYSTEM}. The engineer maintains the validation test equipment. The job does not adjust or repair it. The engineer signs the note in {DOCS}, and a later job files that version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Due dates were hunted across logs, and the service itself cannot be done from a screen.
tasks.enabler_now: The equipment register already stores the next service date.
tasks.still_hard: A fault found on the bench is not in the due list.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer does the maintenance and decides whether the equipment can go back into use.
tasks.altitude: The engineer spends the week on the bench, not on hunting the due list.

reach.task: Keep the equipment after the signed note

evidence.claim: The engineering digest says advice, design, and research stay manual, and the signing engineer stays responsible.
Digest [S14] says the Machinery Regulation covers AI safety functions from 20 January 2027, so this design does not let a model change a test-station safety function.

assumptions: Configure that register before a new store.
unknowns: Who may take equipment out of service.
Whether a calibration certificate is required.
research_questions: How often a due date is missing from the register.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining bench time is still the engineer's own maintenance.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes few assets have a stored due date. The high end assumes most assets have a stored due date. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct validation tests to internal or external standards.

steps.what: Show internal protocols and external standards
Conduct validation tests of existing processes
Conduct qualification tests of equipment and software
Sign the test record for this run

outputs: filed copy of signed test record v1

tasks.design: A job shows the internal protocol and the external standard from {DOCS}. The engineer conducts the validation and qualification tests on the process, the equipment, and the software. A later job files only the signed record.
tasks.previous_blocker: The protocol was printed and walked to the line, and the test itself is not a screen task.
tasks.enabler_now: Protocols and cited standards are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: A test can fail in a way the protocol did not name.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer runs the test and decides what was observed.
tasks.altitude: The engineer spends the week on the test, not on finding the protocol.

reach.task: Run the process while the engineer tests
reach.learn: Which protocol step is in force

evidence.claim: The engineering digest says advice, design, and research stay manual, and the signing engineer stays responsible.
The engineering digest says an artefact generator fills templates from records, a model may draft prose, every number must trace to a record, and the engineer signs.

assumptions: The protocol in the store is the one in force.
Configure that store before a new one.
unknowns: Whether software tests need a separate record.
research_questions: How often the protocol on the bench differs from the stored one.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining test time is still the engineer at the equipment.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes protocols are often paper. The high end assumes protocols are already stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Communicate validation results to regulatory agencies.

steps.what: Check compliance documentation for blank fields
Communicate validation results with regulatory agencies
Sign the agency letter for this version

outputs: filed copy of signed agency letter v1

tasks.design: A job lists blank fields in the compliance file in {DOCS}. The engineer communicates the validation results to the agency. A later job sends only the letter the engineer signed, from {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Letters were assembled by hand, and an incomplete file was easy to send.
tasks.enabler_now: The compliance file has fields a blank check can read.
tasks.still_hard: The agency can ask a question that is not in the file.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer decides what is said and signs the letter before it is sent.

ambition.what: Send a complete letter the day the results are signed, without retyping the file.

tasks.altitude: The engineer spends the week on the agency conversation, not on hunting blank fields.

reach.learn: Which results the letter may state

evidence.claim: Digest [S5] is cited for coded rule checks on records and plan reviews, so blank protocol fields are listed before the engineer decides.
The engineering digest says an artefact generator fills templates from records, a model may draft prose, every number must trace to a record, and the engineer signs.

assumptions: Only the signed letter is sent.
Configure the existing mail record before a new channel.
unknowns: Whether a lawyer must see it first.
research_questions: How often the agency wants a format the file does not hold.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining contact time is still the engineer's own conversation.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes files are often incomplete. The high end assumes files are usually complete. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare and review validation compliance documentation.

steps.what: List blank fields on validation protocols
Prepare engineering change notices and schematics
Review and maintain validation compliance documentation

outputs: filed copy of signed compliance documentation v1

tasks.design: A job lists blank fields on validation protocols in {DOCS}. The engineer prepares the engineering change notices and schematics, reviews the compliance set, and signs it. A later job files that version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Notices, schematics, and protocols were updated in different files, so a blank field survived into the set.
tasks.enabler_now: Protocol fields can be checked without a new store.
tasks.still_hard: A schematic change can be right on the drawing and still conflict with a protocol.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer decides what the notice says and whether the set is complete.

ambition.what: Update the set when a protocol field is blank, without a full retype.

tasks.altitude: The engineer spends the week on the notice and the review, not on the blank-field hunt.

reach.learn: Which protocol version the notice cites

evidence.claim: Digest [S5] is cited for coded rule checks on records and plan reviews, so blank protocol fields are listed before the engineer decides.
The engineering digest says advice, design, and research stay manual, and the signing engineer stays responsible.

assumptions: The protocol store is the controlled copy.
Configure it before adding a new store.
unknowns: Whether a change notice needs a second signature.
research_questions: How often a schematic is revised after the notice is signed.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining review time is still the engineer's reading.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes protocols are poorly structured. The high end assumes protocol fields are mostly present. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The validation engineer spends the week on the test, the deviation, and the signed decision. Filing a signed record can move. A model does not release a protocol or change a live test station.
reach: Quality staff collect a sample only from the list the engineer signed.
A department starts a test only after the signed schedule is filed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a protocol figure that has no source row.
Leave equipment, sampling, and agency contact as their own work.
role.ambitious_version: A signed protocol or report can be filed the same day, and the engineer still releases it.
